dossier.headline: Post-holiday gap-up fades through the afternoon
dossier.summary: Indian stocks opened more than 1,000 points higher on the Sensex on November 11 after the Diwali holiday, and the rally broadened through the morning until all 30 Sensex stocks were in the green. From early afternoon the market eased off the day's high, and by 2 pm it had given back a large part of the morning gain, with IT, pharma and realty weighing while banks still led.
why_it_matters: Cheaper crude and steady foreign buying drove the gap-up despite a hotter US inflation print
The afternoon fade shows how much of the gain was held by banks alone
